questions.text: For the gradient boosted model, what is the AUC (and average precision) under random stratified 5-fold CV versus spatial block CV at the reference block size, each with its spread over 5 repetitions, and what is the difference?
questions.notes: Reference block size fixed by the frozen Moran's I rule (scripts/40). Leakage label 'substantial' by the frozen decision rule.

questions.text: Under spatial block CV at the reference block size, does either model rank held-out gold-producer cells better than chance (mean AUC at least 0.60 and minimum over repetitions above 0.55), and what fraction of held-out positives fall in the top 5 and top 10 percent of cells?
questions.notes: Neither model meets the frozen skill rule at the reference size; the boosted model meets it up to the block size recorded in headline.hgb.largest_block_with_skill_km.

questions.text: Is the analytical batch learnable: how does AUC change when the method family is left out entirely (leave-one-family-out), and when it is added as a covariate (exploratory)?
questions.notes: Leave-one-family-out is confirmatory; the covariate model is exploratory and labelled so in the report.

questions.text: Which elements carry the signal in the held-out predictions, and are they plausible gold pathfinders or lithological proxies? (exploratory)
questions.notes: Sc, V, Fe up and La, Ce, Th down is a lithological (mafic versus felsic) contrast, not a pathfinder signature; no pathfinder element survived the pre-registered suite rule.
